They also mention "Retrieve information about the structure and functioning of a specified type of cell" tool. We can use the function to get info on neurons. Then we can manually describe muscle cells or maybe use the function again for muscle cells but they want less detail. The function has an optional parameter detailed default false. So we can call biology_get_cell_info twice: once with cell_type="neuron", detailed=true; second with cell_type="muscle cell", detailed=false.

We need to output the results. The function returns JSON. We'll call the function via the "functions" tool. We'll produce two calls. Then we will format the answer accordingly.
